messages.content: Could you tell me the name of my spouse, and include her maiden name as well?

function.name: get_spouse_name
function.description: Retrieves the name of spouse. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

spouse_of.description: The name of the individual whose spouse's name is being retrieved.

include_maiden_name.description: Whether to include the maiden name in the returned spouse's full name.

message.content: Sure! To retrieve your spouse’s name along with her maiden name, I’ll just need to know which person’s spouse information you’re looking for. Could you let me know who “you” refers to—your name or another specific individual? Once I have that, I can fetch the details for you.
message.reasoning: We need to call the tool get_spouse_name with parameters spouse_of set to user-provided individual's name (the user didn't specify their own name). We don't have user's name; we cannot guess. According to policy, if insufficient info, respond asking clarification. So ask what person's spouse name they want.
